title: IVF-Labeling annotation record
description: One line of annotations.jsonl. Produced by docs/index.html and by server/label_tool.py.

task_id.description: the queue item this answers, e.g. CLINIC_0001__cs

kind.description: which task family this came from

choices.description: pipe separated allowed answers; required for closed and binary

rationale.description: why this is the answer, citing what is visible in the frame

rationale_basis.description: image = describes visible features; label = merely cites the annotation file

answerable_from.description: image = visible in the frame; clinical_only = needs the record; outcome_only = a follow-up fact, never an image prediction

include_pgt.description: FALSE = non-invasive setting (group A); TRUE = ploidy known (group B)

frame_index.description: frame the answer refers to; null for clip-level answers

boxes.description: x1,y1,x2,y2 in ORIGINAL image pixels; several boxes separated by ';'

box_labels.description: one label per box, pipe separated

source.description: illustration = bundled AI demo frames (never train on them)

then.description: a closed answer needs a choices list to be scorable
